paper_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: What are the key photovoltaic performance parameters of the optimized ternary organic solar cell based on PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO processed with o-xylene?
qa_pairs.answer: The optimized ternary PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO device processed with o-xylene achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 18.63%. This performance is characterized by an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.865 V, a short-circuit current density (JSC) of 27.55 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 78.19%.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: Why was a hot spin-coating process at 100 °C implemented for the fabrication of the PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO active layer?
qa_pairs.answer: A hot spin-coating process at 100 °C was utilized to address the low solubility of the organic photovoltaic materials in the nonhalogenated green solvent, o-xylene. This method helps increase the solubility of the materials in the solvent and improves the resulting morphology of the active layer.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: How does the addition of 10 wt% GS-ISO to the PM6:BTP-BO-4F system affect the acceptor morphology and the open-circuit voltage?
qa_pairs.answer: The addition of 10 wt% GS-ISO leads to the formation of an alloy acceptor model due to the high compatibility between BTP-BO-4F and GS-ISO, which is evidenced by a low interfacial energy of 0.62 mN m⁻¹. This alloy formation is further supported by a linear increase in the open-circuit voltage (VOC) as the GS-ISO content is increased.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: What evidence supports the occurrence of energy transfer between the acceptors in the PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO ternary blend?
qa_pairs.answer: Energy transfer from the GS-ISO guest acceptor to the BTP-BO-4F host acceptor is indicated by photoluminescence (PL) quenching and overlapping spectra. Specifically, the emission peak of GS-ISO at 705 nm is fully quenched in the blended film, signifying efficient energy transfer to the host acceptor.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: Compare the performance and non-radiative voltage loss of PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO ternary cells processed in nitrogen versus those processed in ambient air.
qa_pairs.answer: Ternary cells processed in nitrogen achieved a PCE of 18.63% with a non-radiative voltage loss (ΔVnr) of 0.236 V. In contrast, devices processed in air (50% relative humidity) achieved a lower PCE of 14.13% (which is still over 75% of the N2-processed efficiency) and exhibited a higher ΔVnr of 0.246 V, contributing to a reduced VOC.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: How does the incorporation of GS-ISO into the PM6:BTP-BO-4F system influence charge recombination mechanisms?
qa_pairs.answer: The introduction of GS-ISO effectively suppresses trap-assisted recombination. This is demonstrated by the reduction of the ideality factor (n) from 1.24 in the binary PM6:BTP-BO-4F cells to 1.11 in the optimized ternary cells, where a value closer to 1 indicates minimized trap-assisted losses.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: What improvements in molecular stacking and crystallinity are observed when GS-ISO is added to the PM6:BTP-BO-4F film?
qa_pairs.answer: According to GIWAXS analysis, the addition of GS-ISO improves molecular stacking in the active layer. The crystal coherence length (CCL) in the out-of-plane direction increases from 17.92 Å in the binary film to 20.41 Å in the ternary film, and the π-π stacking distance decreases from 3.70 Å to 3.64 Å.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process

qa_pairs.question: Describe the charge transport balance and mobility values for the optimized PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO ternary blend.
qa_pairs.answer: The optimized ternary blend (10 wt% GS-ISO) exhibits more balanced charge transport with a mobility ratio of 1.25. The measured hole mobility (μh) is 5.57 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and the electron mobility (μe) is 6.94 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹.
qa_pairs.source_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process
